_comment: Ordered list of images for the Families & Kids gallery. Order matters — the first image leads the page. To swap an image, replace the filename and rewrite the alt text. Files live in public/images/families/. Never include a child's name or age in alt text (Requirements §28).

images.alt: A young girl in a pink dress standing at a wooden fence in late afternoon light
Black and white overhead photograph of a family lying together on a quilt in the grass
A mother and her daughter leaning together against a fence, laughing
Black and white close portrait of a girl with a flower tucked into her hair
Two young siblings pressed cheek to cheek outdoors
A baby holding a teddy bear, photographed outdoors in soft light
A young boy walking along a wooden boardwalk through tall grass

_gapsToFill: Larger families of five or more
_excluded: Three family images in matching white tops and khakis (they contradict the coordinate-don't-match guidance on the What to Wear page), two kids by the pond (wide-angle distortion, cluttered background), and girl with long shadow (dated processing).
